evidence.citation: Artifact: "inspect `git status`... identify only files created or modified by the runner"; "Do not use broad cleanup commands"; "Re-check `git status`"; "Re-run the case with a fresh, context-free runner"; "After the rerun, sweep the live checkout again with `git status`, then send the artifact plus the skill’s first principles and the case bar to a separate fresh judge."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact’s work is targeted at integrity, isolation, provenance, and reproducibility: selective cleanup to avoid harming unrelated checkout changes, rerunning with a fresh runner after blindness was broken, and post-run leak inspection. Under the supplied bar, those controls and their repetition are necessary rather than materially unnecessary execution work.
